papers.title_en: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice Agent Collaboration
papers.authors: Yingda Shen, Yuxiang Wang, Kunyu Feng, Qinke Ni, Jiaqi Li, Minghao Hsu, Junan Zhang, Dekun Chen, Yutong Bian, Zhizheng Wu
papers.evidence: 全双工语音智能体协作框架，协调异步任务并保持会话响应
papers.tldr: 全双工语音代理难以完成复杂推理与工具使用，与编码代理协作的 harness 常依赖启发式不易优化。DuplexAgent 将工作流拆为六个可编辑模块，并通过 Duplex-Harness-RSI 闭环从模拟器失败轨迹诊断并修订。模拟器生成定时测试，Exam Planner 与 Harness Editor 驱动模块改进。实验表明其 spoken-knowledge 与 executable-tool 指标优于对比系统，保持强中断响应。
papers.abstract_en: Voice agents are converging on a collaboration pattern: a full-duplex interaction model stays on the live channel as the entry to the conversation, while search, reasoning, and coding are handled through asynchronous delegation. A duplex model supports continuous listening and speaking, but complex reasoning and tool use may exceed its capabilities. A coding agent can plan and execute extended tasks, but its sequential interface is a poor fit for live conversation. Combining them requires a harness that coordinates task acceptance, progress, cancellation, replacement, and result delivery while keeping the conversation responsive. Existing harnesses often rely on coupled heuristics, making them difficult to improve systematically from evidence. We present DuplexAgent, a full-duplex collaboration system whose harness expresses this workflow as six editable modules, and Duplex-Harness-RSI, a closed loop that revises them from interaction traces. A simulator automatically generates timed test conversations, runs the system, and produces failure traces that identify the collaboration modules requiring repair. Reasoning LLMs and coding agents in the delegation pool also serve the improvement loop: the Exam Planner selects the next tests from observed weaknesses and the repair archive, and the Harness Editor proposes targeted module changes. The capabilities that serve the user thus also improve the system's coordination. Experiments on intelligence, agentic, and duplex benchmarks show that DuplexAgent combines continuous interaction with difficult reasoning and complex task execution, achieving stronger spoken-knowledge and executable-tool scores than the compared delegated systems while maintaining strong interruption response. A harness ablation further shows that this modular, verifiable loop outperforms the initial harness and repeated editing that lacks its diagnosis and repair archive.

papers.title_en: DuplexAct: How Interactive Are Frontier Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models?
papers.authors: Jiaheng Dong, Shihong Tan, Gongping Huang, Jean Honorio, Abhirup Ghosh, Ting Dang
papers.evidence: 用于评估端到端全双工口语语言模型交互行为的基准，直接面向基于LLM的全双工语音对话智能体。
papers.tldr: 现有全双工语音模型交互评估缺乏结构化动作级指标，常只关注动作发生而非成功，场景覆盖有限。本文提出DuplexAct基准，定义三层动作分类，涵盖8个交互动作和24个条件，并设计即时执行与后续跟进的评估指标。基准包含4691个测试实例，覆盖闲聊、会议、客服、面试，其中2531个来自真实录音。该框架为系统评估端到端全双工语音模型的交互参与度提供结构化、真实场景基础。
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end (E2E) full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable simutanous listening and speaking continously, requiring models to take appropriate interaction actions as conversations unfold. However, existing benchmarks lack a structured action-level formulation, often evaluate action occurrence rather than success, and provide limited coverage of diverse real-world conversations. We introduce DuplexAct, a benchmark for evaluating interaction action taking in E2E FD-SLMs. DuplexAct defines a three-level action taxonomy spanning eight interaction actions and 24 corresponding interaction conditions. We further characterize successful action-taking through immediate execution and subsequent follow-through, and develop action-specific evaluation metrics for both. DuplexAct contains 4,691 test instances spanning casual conversation, meetings, customer service, and interviews, including 2,531 instances derived from real-world conversational recordings. Together, DuplexAct provides a structured and real-world-grounded framework for systematically assessing how E2E FD-SLMs participate in ongoing spoken interaction.

papers.title_en: Full-duplex Spoken Language Modeling with Discrete Diffusion
papers.authors: Chen Chen, Pin-Jui Ku, Ankita Pasad, Ante Jukić, Zhehuai Chen, Boris Ginsburg
papers.evidence: 基于离散扩散的全双工口语语言模型，低延迟，持续跟踪用户语音
papers.tldr: 现有全双工口语模型难以兼顾语言智能与响应效率，常把说话时机与内容压缩在单一自回归时间线。Diffuplex 基于离散扩散，在训练层面分离“何时说”与“说什么”，推理时用 AR 策略跟踪用户语音，并行扩散生成和优化回复。思考模式下每前向 13.0 tokens、平均 1872 tokens/s，超越前沿自回归模型解码速度；无思考模式首音延迟与现有全双工模型相当，但语言智能显著更强。该工作为口语智能体开辟实时对话与并行智能生成的新范式。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Diffuplex, a full-duplex spoken language model based on discrete diffusion that achieves an unprecedented balance between linguistic intelligence and response efficiency. With thinking mode, Diffuplex delivers 13.0 tokens per forward pass, reaching an average of 1872 tokens per second and substantially surpassing the frontier autoregressive (AR) models in decoding speed. Without thinking, Diffuplex matches the first-audio latency of existing full-duplex models while achieving markedly stronger linguistic intelligence. This capability is enabled by separating when to say from what to say at the training level, rather than compressing both into a single autoregressive timeline. During inference, Diffuplex continuously tracks the user speech through an AR interaction policy, while independently generating and refining response content through parallel diffusion. Consequently, semantic computation is no longer bounded by the perception audio frame rate, allowing intelligence and responsiveness to improve simultaneously. Taken together, these results establish a new paradigm for spoken agents that can sustain real-time dialogue while devoting parallel computation to intelligent response generation. Training code and checkpoints will be avaliable soon.

papers.title_en: SmoothConv and DuplexConv: Complementary Mandarin Multi-Party Conversational Speech Corpora for Speech Interaction
papers.authors: Chengyou Wang, Mingchen Shao, Chunjiang He, Zeyu Zhu, Jierui Guo, Bingshen Mu, Zikai Liu, Hanke Xie, Yuhang Dai, Zhou Zhu, Lei Xie
papers.evidence: 多方对话语音语料库，包含话轮转换、重叠语音和说话人协调，针对复杂语音交互和全双工行为
papers.tldr: 多轮对话语音交互需建模轮流发言、重叠语音等复杂行为，但现有普通话多方对话语料常缺少同步参与者级语音轨道和细粒度标注。本文推出 SmoothConv 与 DuplexConv 两个互补语料库，共 2100 小时，前者人工验证，后者自动标注可扩展。发布 SmoothConv 基准并在语音分离、多说话人自动语音识别和轮次检测任务上验证，证明该资源对多方语音交互建模有效。语料及基准已公开。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large audio language models (LALMs) have driven the development of natural and intelligent speech interaction systems. Such systems need to model complex conversational behaviors, including turn-taking, overlapping speech, and speaker coordination. Multi-party conversations provide a realistic setting for studying these behaviors, yet existing Mandarin conversational corpora often lack synchronized participant-level speech tracks and comprehensive annotations. In this work, we introduce SmoothConv and DuplexConv, two complementary Mandarin multi-party conversational speech corpora totaling 2,100 hours. SmoothConv provides human-verified conversations for reliable analysis and evaluation, while DuplexConv offers large-scale automatically annotated conversations through a scalable pipeline for model training. Both corpora provide synchronized participant-level speech tracks and multi-dimensional fine-grained annotations. We further release the SmoothConv Benchmark and evaluate these resources on speech separation, multi-speaker automatic speech recognition (MSASR), and turn detection tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the utility of the proposed resources for multi-party speech interaction modeling. The datasets, benchmark, and related resources are publicly available.

papers.title_en: SteerablePlex: Can We Steer Full-Duplex Models?
papers.authors: Haolong Zheng, Maike Züfle, Dominik Macháček, Peter Polák, Xulin Fan, Xavier Sumba, Siyin Wang, Ondřej Klejch, Mark Hasegawa-Johnson
papers.evidence: 全双工语音模型，指令遵循与场景控制
papers.tldr: 全双工语音模型能同时听说，但随对话历史增长控制难度增大，用作用户模拟器时易偏离预设场景，导致评估不可靠。为此提出SimIF-Bench基准检验模型是否按顺序完成多目标，并基于GDPO设计训练配方，使模型在连续对话中遵循文本指令且保持轮流发言。构建的SteerablePlex与异步后端语言模型相连，由后端监控对话并按需提供指令，比现有开源模型和GPT-Realtime更可靠遵循多阶段约束，显著提升了全双工模型的可控性，为可靠用户模拟提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak simultaneously, enabling natural interaction, but become increasingly difficult to control as the conversation history grows. When used as user simulators, this lack of control can cause them to deviate from prescribed scenarios and produce unreliable evaluation outcomes. We introduce SimIF-Bench (Simulator Instruction-Following Benchmark), which evaluates whether a conversational model stays within a prescribed scenario and completes multiple goals in the required order. The benchmark reveals that current open-source full-duplex models struggle to follow such constraints. We then introduce a Group Reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO)-based training recipe that enables a full-duplex model to follow textual instructions during an ongoing conversation while maintaining its turn-taking ability. By connecting the resulting SteerablePlex to an asynchronous backend language model that monitors the conversation and provides instructions when needed, we build a more controllable full-duplex user simulator that follows multi-stage constraints more reliably than existing open-source models and GPT-Realtime.

papers.title_en: DiffuPlex: Accelerating Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models via Rolling Masked Diffusion
papers.authors: Heeseung Kim
papers.evidence: 利用掩码扩散加速全双工口语对话模型
papers.tldr: 全双工口语对话模型虽支持同时听说，但细粒度模型每帧仍自回归推进骨干，导致计算开销大。DiffuPlex提出滚动掩码扩散框架，单次骨干唤醒预测多个未来用户和助手帧，仅消耗自信前缀，交互保持原帧率。据推理策略不同，LISTEN和SPEAK分别实现1.46倍和1.59倍墙钟加速，核心LM加速达1.61倍和1.80倍，且所有骨干调用在80ms内完成。该框架在保持交互行为与通用能力的同时显著降低计算成本。
papers.abstract_en: Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.

papers.title_en: People Making Conversation: Evaluating How Naturally Speech Models Converse
papers.authors: Arya Bastani, Iman Modarressi
papers.evidence: 在停顿和转换点评估实时语音模型的自然转话
papers.tldr: 现有语音模型评估未关注实时对话中“是否说话”的决策。本研究在176段自然对话的427个停顿和482个话轮结束处，对比六个实时语音系统与人类行为。托管API几乎在每个停顿都响应，延迟1-4秒（静音端点）或8秒（语义检测）；全双工模型能保持沉默并快速打断，且托管系统回复更长。文本记忆上托管系统为41-60%，全双工音频为17-22%，作者发布数据与框架以改进评估。
papers.abstract_en: A conversational speech model has to decide, at every pause, whether to speak. Existing evaluations test boundary detection, policy adherence, or aggregate statistics, not this decision. We place real-time speech systems at 427 pauses and 482 turn ends from 176 unscripted conversations in Seamless Interaction, give each the conversation so far, and score what it generates against what the person did: whether and how soon it speaks at a pause; its latency, length, and wording at a turn end; and whether it can answer a question about the preceding 30 to 120 seconds. Across six systems, the hosted APIs (GPT Realtime, Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, Grok Voice) respond at almost every pause whichever endpointer they use; only their latency, about 1 to 4 s with silence-based endpointers and about 8 s with semantic turn detection, decides whether the words land inside the pause. The full-duplex models (PersonaPlex, Moshi) are the only systems that regularly stay silent and the only ones that interrupt within a human reaction time. Hosted systems reply longer than the person. Given the history as text, hosted systems recall 41 to 60% of conversation facts under a Claude Opus 5.5 judge and 19 to 26% under a strict word matcher; hearing it as audio, full-duplex models recall 17 to 22% and 12 to 15%. We release the labels, points, harness, and every output.

papers.title_en: RUBATO: Decoupled Clocks Allow Full-Duplex Models to Think as Fast as They Can
papers.authors: Yi-Jen Shih, Puyuan Peng, Haohe Liu, David Harwath, Abdelrahman Mohamed
papers.evidence: 全双工模型采用解耦时钟实现实时内部思考
papers.tldr: 现有全双工语音模型强制思考流采用固定解码速率，无法适应硬件差异。RUBATO提出多流位置编码，为各流分配独立时钟实现完全解耦，支持零样本速度插值。训练只需两种极端速率，部署时可平滑适应任意中间速率。在Spoken GSM8K上，基线模型精度跌至1.7%，RUBATO-Full维持48.7%至51.1%，答案时间缩短6.5倍，并在复杂打断场景中显著优于基线。
papers.abstract_en: Recent Speech Full-Duplex (FDX) models are capable of engaging in naturalistic conversation by listening and speaking at the same time. Building on this foundation, recent architectures introduce internal thinking streams to enhance their intelligence. To guarantee these streams process successfully in real time, existing methods enforce a fixed decoding rate, which assumes a hardware profile capable of a specific latency. We argue this static approach is severely suboptimal. Because internal thinking is intrinsically asynchronous, an ideal FDX model should sustain real-time conversational flow while allowing each stream to decode at its own hardware-adaptive rate. Thinking streams must process as fast as the hardware allows to deliver accurate answers faster. To solve this, we propose RUBATO, a novel multistream positional encoding that assigns independent clocks to entirely decouple the streams. This structural isolation empowers the model to zero-shot interpolate across any inference decoding speed. It drastically simplifies dataset construction by requiring training on only two extreme decoding speeds while smoothly adapting to any intermediate rate during deployment. RUBATO demonstrates consistent robustness across five spoken reasoning tasks. On Spoken GSM8K, a baseline model collapses to 1.7% accuracy at interpolated speeds. Conversely, RUBATO-Full sustains 48.7% to 51.1% accuracy across all rates, leveraging faster hardware to achieve a 6.5x shorter time-to-answer with a constant time-to-first-response. This advantage holds on BIG-Bench Audio and amplifies significantly during complex full-duplex interruptions. Specifically, when a user interjects while the model is actively speaking and reasoning, RUBATO-Full achieves 40.0% to 45.1% accuracy, whereas the baseline fails completely.

papers.title_en: D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones
papers.authors: Cheng-Kuang Chang, Alexander H. Liu, Brian Kingsbury, Hilde Kuehne, Rogerio Feris, Samuel Thomas, James Glass, Kai-Wei Chang
papers.evidence: 将半双工口语语言模型转换为全双工，支持同时听和说
papers.tldr: 全双工口语语言模型支持同时听说，但通用能力通常落后于半双工模型。为此，本文提出Dialogue-to-Duplex（D2）框架，通过无解码器表示蒸馏将音频编码器适配为流式，并利用监督微调学习全双工交互，从而将预训练HD-SLM转换为细粒度高能力FD-SLM。在Qwen3-Omni上以12.5Hz更新率，Qwen3-Omni-D2实现99.2%轮流发言成功率、521ms延迟、99.5%打断成功率和70.1的VoiceBench得分，达到最新水平。该框架为构建高性能实时语音对话系统提供了通用且有效的迁移方案。
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) support simultaneous listening and speaking, but often lag behind half-duplex spoken language models (HD-SLMs) in general capabilities. We propose Dialogue-to-Duplex (D2), a framework that converts pretrained HD-SLMs into high-capability FD-SLMs at fine temporal granularity. D2 adapts the original audio encoder to streaming through decoder-free representation distillation and learns full-duplex interaction through supervised fine-tuning. We systematically study the effects of chunk size on full-duplex interaction, general capabilities, and inference computation. We apply D2 to two distinct HD-SLM architectures, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2. At a 12.5Hz update rate, Qwen3-Omni-D2 achieves 99.2% turn-taking success with 521-ms latency, 99.5% interruption success, and a state-of-the-art VoiceBench score of 70.1.

papers.title_en: MultiPartyTurnBench: Benchmarking Floor Control in Multi-Party Spoken Dialogue
papers.authors: Puneet Mathur, Dinesh Manocha
papers.evidence: 针对全双工多说话人语音的轮次结束与插话检测基准，支持插话处理
papers.tldr: 全双工语音系统需在多人对话中准确判断何时进入、保持或放弃话语权，但现有评估缺乏对真实话语权转移与易混淆非事件的统一受控测试。本文提出MultiPartyTurnBench（MPTB），含240个合成通道分离对话，覆盖2-5人和6种交互类型，评估话轮结束与打断检测。结果显示EOT检测较好，但打断检测漏检或误报，全双工智能体选择性打断处理接近随机。该基准揭示选择性话语权控制是多人语音交互中尚未解决的关键挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex speech systems must decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor, even as multiple speakers overlap or backchannel without taking it. Existing evaluations study dyadic turn-taking or end-to-end agent behavior, but lack a unified, controlled evaluation of genuine floor transitions against confusable non-events in multi-party settings. We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB), a benchmark of 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types. MPTB evaluates two complementary tasks: End-of-Turn (EOT) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption (INT) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from non-floor-taking speech. Exact event-conditioned annotations enable causal evaluation using false-positive-constrained recall and signed latency. Across acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection baselines, we find a stark asymmetry: learned systems achieve 82.5-92.6% EOT recall at 4.3-11.8% false-positive rates, while INT detection suffers from missed takeovers or excessive false activations. This asymmetry extends to five full-duplex agents which achieve 86.1-95.8% balanced accuracy on turn entry, yet perform near chance (46.9-54.7%) on selective interruption handling. Gemini-3.8-Live yields to 97.7% of backchannels, whereas MiniCPM-o-4.5 yields to only 1.4% of genuine interruptions. These findings establish selective floor control as a distinct, unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.

papers.title_en: Phonology-Aware Speaker Extraction Frontend for Audio LLMs
papers.authors: Yanxiang Chen, Haoyuan Deng, Jinyu Wang, Hongyi Chen, Dingshan Li, Runlin Huang, Weifeng Su
papers.evidence: 目标说话人提取前端处理重叠语音用于音频LLM
papers.tldr: 多语言重叠语音中目标说话人提取需求异质，固定深度前端常浪费计算或欠处理。LATTE前端结合声学难度估计器、任务自适应音系先验与自适应沙漏提取器，在无语言身份下路由每个混合。在PolyExtract上以0.30 GFLOPs取得15.07 dB SI-SNRi，计算减少43.4%，WER降至14.6%。该方案为质量感知、计算高效的多语言TSE及Audio-LLM部署提供了实用框架。
papers.abstract_en: Target speaker extraction (TSE) is a key frontend for enabling audio large language models (LLMs) to recognize and understand a designated speaker in overlapping speech. However, multilingual mixtures exhibit heterogeneous extraction demands, causing fixed-depth systems to either under-process challenging inputs or waste computation on inputs that have already converged. Existing TSE frontends generally apply uniform computation, while Audio-LLM adaptation methods neither explicitly model language-conditioned extraction demands nor preserve plug-and-play compatibility with frozen downstream models. We therefore propose LATTE, a lightweight 5.2M-parameter frontend that combines an acoustic Difficulty Estimator, a task-adaptive phonology-informed prior learned from multi-depth TSE gains, and an Adaptive Hourglass Extractor to route each mixture without requiring language identity at inference. On PolyExtract, LATTE achieves a macro SI-SNRi of 15.07 dB at 0.30 GFLOPs, retaining performance within 0.09 dB of a 0.53-GFLOP fixed-depth model while reducing computation by 43.4%, and lowers the average WER from 16.8% to 14.6% relative to TF-GridNet. By jointly modeling sample-level extraction demands and phonological structure, LATTE provides a practical framework for quality-aware, compute-efficient multilingual TSE and offers a scalable path toward robust Audio-LLM deployment.

papers.title_en: AudioTETRIS: Token Elimination via Transitional Importance Signals for Efficient Audio LLMs
papers.authors: Shreya Sajid, Anna Vettoruzzo, Joaquin Vanschoren
papers.evidence: 面向音频大模型的高效令牌压缩，直接支持低延迟语音对话
papers.tldr: 大型音频语言模型因音频编码器产生大量token导致推理计算高，现有训练免费压缩方法忽视频谱过渡破坏语音细节。AudioTETRIS利用音频编码器表示几何作为声学先验，与注意力压缩结合计算融合得分，实现训练免费的渐进token选择。在多个模型上仅用25% token保持近原始性能，中等压缩下超过全token，一致优于基线。
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on speech-text tasks, but standard audio encoders produce hundreds of tokens for even short audio clips. Because self-attention scales quadratically in sequence length, this inflates inference-time compute substantially. Current training-free token compression methods prune or merge tokens based solely on coarse attention or feature similarity. However, treating audio tokens as generic, isotropic features smooths over spectral transitions, destroying fine-grained phonetic transitions essential for decoding speech. In contrast, speech signals exhibit highly structured temporal patterns where information density peaks at acoustic transitions. We propose AudioTETRIS, a training-free, two-stage framework that uses the audio encoder's representation geometry as an acoustic prior for token importance before applying attention-based compression. Instead of discarding encoder structure after the encoding stage, AudioTETRIS propagates this prior directly into the LLM decoder to compute a per-token fused score. This score drives progressive top-$k$ token selection across decoder layers without requiring additional training or auxiliary models. Evaluated on Qwen2-Audio-7B, Phi-4-Multimodal, and Audio Flamingo 3, AudioTETRIS retains near-uncompressed performance on several speech tasks using only 25% of audio tokens, matches or surpasses full-token accuracy at moderate compression rates, and consistently outperforms existing training-free baselines.

papers.title_en: RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution
papers.authors: Daijin Hu, Xi Wang
papers.evidence: 流式语音助手工具执行控制实现低延迟
papers.tldr: 流式语音助手可提前启动工具以降低等待时间，但用户后续自我修正会使看似稳定的参数失效，产生不可逆的陈旧执行。提出RASSG，在连续三个一致且参数非空的识别结果出现时启动工具，并结合校准的参数无效风险与执行成本在不可逆前主动取消。在ReCAST修复子集上，RASSG将陈旧执行率从50.00%降至3.15%，成功轨迹平均延迟3.676秒，且优于所有早期执行基线。消融实验证明主动取消进行中调用能有效避免不可逆影响，提升流式工具执行的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical nonempty arguments, then combines calibrated argument invalidity risk with execution costs to decide cancellation at the last feasible opportunity before effects become irreversible. Evaluation on ReCAST, FDB-v3, and Audio2Tool uses a controlled execution clock with fixed tool runtimes and cancellation parameters. On ReCAST's prospective-repair subset, RASSG reduces the stale execution rate from LocalAgreement-2's 50.00% to 3.15%, with a mean delay of 3.676s across successful trajectories. The stale reduction also holds against every early-execution baseline on both public speech datasets. Ablations with identical initial launches support active cancellation, showing the value of controlling ongoing calls before their effects become irreversible. Code and data are available at https://github.com/daijinhu/RASSG.

papers.title_en: Soloist: A Generative Model for Blind Voice Separation in the Wild
papers.authors: Chen Yang, ChuFan Yu, Botian Jiang, Jingqi Chen, Wenxuan Wang, Yitian Gong, Zhaoye Fei, Xipeng Qiu
papers.evidence: 从重叠语音和噪声中盲分离语音，支持全双工语音接口中的打断检测和重叠语音处理。
papers.tldr: 真实语音分离需从重叠语音、环境噪声和音乐中恢复个体声音，但孤立源录音稀缺且说话人数量未知。Soloist 以混合音频为条件，自回归生成音频编解码序列形式的个体语音流，无需目标说话人查询或预设语音数。训练分两阶段：先用合成混合做监督分离并预测真实录音说话人时间线，再用强化学习对真实录音优化，由模型评判器奖励语音纯度和内容保留。在多种场景下恢复干净语音、提取歌唱人声，并集成到全双工对话流水线形成连续说话人轨迹。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world voice separation must recover individual voices from overlapping speech, environmental noise, and music, yet isolated source recordings are rarely available for supervision. We introduce Soloist, a generative model for blind voice separation that autoregressively generates individual voice streams as audio-codec sequences conditioned on the mixture, without requiring a target-speaker query or a predefined voice count. We propose a two-stage training paradigm to learn from synthetic mixtures and adapt to real recordings. The first stage combines supervised separation on synthetic mixtures with isolated source targets and an auxiliary task that predicts speaker timelines from real recordings, learning who speaks when from natural acoustics. The second stage applies reinforcement learning to real recordings, with rewards supplied by a model judge that compares candidate separations based on voice purity and content preservation without isolated source targets. Across diverse scenarios, Soloist recovers clean speech from multi-speaker overlap and noisy recordings, and extracts singing vocals from music accompaniment while maintaining relatively high pitch accuracy and intelligibility. On real-world recordings with unknown voice counts, Soloist also separates voices well. Finally, we integrate Soloist into a full-duplex conversation processing pipeline that assembles separated outputs into continuous speaker tracks, demonstrating its practical utility in real conversations.

papers.title_en: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Yichen Liu, Chunfeng Yuan, Haowei Liu, Wenjuan Li, Zefeng Lin, Bing Li, Xu Chen, Weiming Hu
papers.evidence: 提出基于事件和查询感知图增强的记忆系统，直接支持对话智能体的多轮对话管理。
papers.tldr: 长期会话代理需要记忆系统，但现有扁平或图结构记忆分别存在关系隐式与构建成本高的问题。QGMem 将历史组织为事件索引的原子单元并合并成动态痕迹，通过混合检索与查询感知重排激活紧凑工作记忆。进一步将工作记忆构为局部图并编码为图 token 与文本一同输入 LLM，增强证据利用。在六个基准上实现检索、多跳组合、冲突解决和超长对话推理的一致提升。
papers.abstract_en: For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories. To address these limitations, we propose QGMem, a novel memory construction and activation framework motivated by human memory, in which experience is organized into events and query-relevant events are modeled by graph as working memory. QGMem converts long dialogue histories into event-indexed atomic memory units that preserve individual experiences and consolidates related units into dynamic memory traces that retain state trajectories and current states. When a query arrives, hybrid memory retrieval gathers complementary candidate memories, and query-aware reranking activates the most relevant units as a compact working memory. To expose relational dependencies in the working memory and support conflict-aware reasoning, QGMem organizes the working memory as a local graph, which is then encoded as a graph token and provided to the LLM together with the textual working memory to improve evidence utilization during answer generation. Experiments across six benchmarks validate the framework and show consistent gains in retrieval, multi-hop evidence composition, conflict resolution, and ultra-long dialogue reasoning with compact contexts and moderate inference cost.

papers.title_en: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
papers.authors: Heeseung Kim
papers.evidence: 基于第一人称多模态流的主动语音辅助，决策何时说话与说什么，应对复杂真实场景语音交互
papers.tldr: 可穿戴AR助手需依据第一人称多模态流主动提供口语指导，但现有系统未能同时解决何时说与说什么的问题。EgoVoice从HoloAssist视频构建干净音频流，将会话转化为逐时刻静默或指导决策任务，微调全模态LLM并用直接偏好优化改进主动干预。实验表明现有模型鲜有时机恰当且有意义的主动干预，而EgoVoice在干预时机、内容相关性和人类偏好上显著优于零样本骨干。该框架为主动自我中心口语助手提供了训练与评估新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

papers.title_en: Frontend-Assisted Large Audio-Language Models for SLT2026 SmartGlasses Challenge
papers.authors: Yushi Wang, Zeyan Song, Xiaobin Rong, Chengwei Liu, Jun Gao, Jing Lu
papers.evidence: 针对重叠语音和复杂声学条件的ASR系统，有助于自然打断语音交互
papers.tldr: 针对SLT2026智能眼镜挑战赛Track1的带时间戳说话人归属语音识别任务，我们面对双人对话中重叠语音、背景噪声和远场条件的挑战，采用SoulX-Transcriber多模态大语言模型直接处理全长度音频并生成结构化转录。此外，我们引入基于规则引导源分离和数据驱动语音分离两种前端辅助方法，两者均在验证集上有效提升性能。考虑推理稳定性，最终提交微调后的SoulX-Transcriber系统，在测试集上取得6.22的tcpCER，证明了前端辅助大型音频语言模型在复杂声学场景下的实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: This paper describes our systems for the Track 1 time-stamped speaker-attributed ASR task of the SmartGlasses Challenge. To handle overlapping speech, background noise and far-field conditions in two-person conversations, we employ SoulX-Transcriber, a multimodal large language model that takes full-length audio as input and generates structured transcriptions. In addition, we investigate the effect of speech frontend processing, including a rule-based Guided Source Separation method and a data-driven speech separation model, both of which improve performance on the validation set. Considering inference stability, our final submission uses the fine-tuned SoulX-Transcriber system, achieving a tcpCER of 6.22 on the test set.

papers.title_en: The AI's Poker Face: Contrasting Persuasion and Sycophancy in Voice-Based Multi-Turn Conversations
papers.authors: Ilia Frantzi, Bernie Hogan, Max M. Lang, Paul C. Bauer
papers.evidence: 与LLM进行多轮语音对话并研究说服行为
papers.tldr: 随着大语言模型交互普及，人工智能在持续对话中如何影响用户信念仍不清楚。本研究开展随机对照实验（样本六百一十六），让参与者与语音多轮对话中的大语言模型交流，设置非指令与两种对立指令条件，围绕女权议题观察意见变化、修辞策略与谄媚。结果显示指令条件均使意见向指定立场偏移，但亲女权偏移更大，非指令条件也偏向亲女权；社会谄媚虽普遍存在，却与意见改变无关，仅影响主观体验。研究揭示了论证与谄媚在人工智能影响中的不同作用。
papers.abstract_en: As interactions with large language models (LLMs) become increasingly routine, concerns about their capacity to influence users' beliefs grow. Yet how such influence unfolds in sustained dialogue remains insufficiently understood. We conduct a randomized controlled experiment (N=616) where participants engage in multi-turn, spoken dialogue with an LLM under three conditions: non-directive, and two directive conditions maintaining opposing stances on a polarizing topic (the merits of feminism). We examine opinion change, rhetorical strategies, and sycophancy, distinguishing the semantic content of LLM argumentation from the pragmatic strategies used to manage the interaction. Both directive conditions shifted opinions toward their assigned stances, but asymmetrically: shifts were larger for pro-feminist positions, which also elicited distinct rhetorical strategies. The non-directive condition, likewise shifted opinions pro-feminism. Social sycophancy, though near-universal, was not associated with opinion change; instead it shaped users' subjective experience. Our findings highlight distinct roles for argumentation and sycophantic accommodation in AI influence.

papers.title_en: From Retrieval to Reconstruction: Constructing Evolvable Cognitive Memory for Long-Term Dialogue
papers.authors: Zirui Liao, Zhengxian Wu, Zhuohong Chen, Yunyao Yu, Xiaoyu Liu, Yifan Xu, Haoqian Wang
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的长期对话记忆支持多轮对话管理
papers.tldr: 现有长期对话记忆系统多将记忆作为被动存储，难以区分主观信念与客观事实，也难以连接跨会话证据。本文提出 CogMem，基于 PEC²F 图模式将对话增量转化为带来源证明的图记录，并通过整合与调和形成可演化的记忆。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上，CogMem 在多跳、时间性和知识更新任务中表现优异。消融与探针实验证明认知分离、整合与主动检索的互补贡献，显著提升长期推理可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) serving as long-term dialogue agents require memory systems that support reliable reasoning over extended interactions. However, existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks typically treat memory as passive storage, making it difficult to distinguish source-attributed beliefs from unattributed event/fact records and to connect evidence dispersed across sessions. We introduce CogMem, a cognitive memory architecture based on the PEC$^2$F (Person-Event-Concept-Claim-Fact) graph schema. Dedicated Claim nodes preserve the source and target of subjective statements, while Fact and Event nodes represent semantic and episodic knowledge. Dialogue turns are incrementally converted into provenance-aware graph records, consolidated into higher-level facts, and reconciled into temporally scoped Claim views when the same source provides conflicting updates. For retrieval, a rule-based controller driven by LLM intent parsing composes four deterministic graph operators---anchoring, traversal, intersection, and evidence grounding---to reconstruct query-relevant context. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show strong performance, especially on multi-hop, temporal, and knowledge-update tasks. Ablations and a semantic-collapse probe support complementary contributions from epistemic separation, consolidation, and agentic retrieval. Code: https://github.com/Silent-Rain02/CogMem.

papers.title_en: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
papers.authors: Jiatan Huang, Zheyuan Zhang, Ziming Li, Tianyi Ma, Mingchen Li, Yanfang Ye, Chuxu Zhang
papers.evidence: 交互式LLM智能体的澄清机制改善多轮对话对齐
papers.tldr: LLM代理执行复杂任务时需对齐用户未言明的目标与约束，澄清是实现交互式意图对齐的关键。CLEAT框架通过共同训练澄清价值控制器与任务策略，利用配对rollouts估计残余查询价值，指导有用提问并利用回答改善决策。在四个基准的全部十个评估设置中，CLEAT以Qwen3-4B取得最高平均分，在UserGym Travel和IN3上分别比最强基线提升13.2和6.5个百分点。消融实验表明协同训练在推理时移除控制器仍可改善任务策略，自适应澄清指导随策略演化进一步增益。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification. Yet clarification is useful only when the agent can turn the answer into better decisions. As training changes how the agent handles incomplete information and uses additional answers, the same clarification can become more or less useful. We introduce CLEAT (CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-Training), a framework that co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy from shared interaction outcomes. We formulate residual query value to measure the task utility gained by asking rather than proceeding under the current policy, and estimate it through paired rollouts from the same interaction history. These paired returns train the controller to predict clarification value and the task policy to select useful questions and act on the answers. The controller guides subsequent rollout collection, while outcomes from the updated agent provide new value labels that allow clarification guidance to adapt as the agent learns. With Qwen3-4B, CLEAT achieves the highest mean score in all ten evaluation settings across four benchmarks. Gains over the strongest baseline reach 13.2 and 6.5 percentage points on UserGym Travel and IN3 underspecification judgment accuracy, respectively. Ablations show that co-training improves the task policy even when the controller is removed at inference, while adapting clarification guidance to the evolving policy yields further gains.

papers.title_en: MADS: Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation for Robust Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Arkajyoti Chakraborty, Adam Zernik, Ishika Kulkarni, Mudit Arora, Hugo Lin, Justin Chiu, Alessandro Di Bari, Neha Gupta, Andreas Stolcke
papers.evidence: 多智能体对话模拟用于鲁棒对话代理对抗条件
papers.tldr: 任务型对话代理在真实场景中常因用户非合作行为而脆弱，但现有函数调用基准对对抗性轨迹覆盖不足，制约了鲁棒模型训练。本文提出MADS多智能体对话模拟流水线，注入对抗性交互生成结构化多样对话轨迹，并构建MADS-Bench基准。该基准涵盖6个领域、55个角色、1095个对话，约66%的对话包含易失败的场景。通过结合监督微调与可验证奖励的强化学习两阶段训练，验证了该基准对提升对话代理鲁棒性的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under realistic conditions, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present MADS (Multi-Agent Dialog Simulation), a synthetic data generation pipeline that produces structured, diverse dialogue trajectories. We inject adversarial conversation, producing validated conversation trajectories that capture realistic, unhappy paths. Using MADS, we construct MADS-Bench: a benchmark spanning six domains, 55 personas, and 1095 conversations, with approximately 66% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We evaluate the robustness of the trained models using a two-stage training approach that combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).
